name: Gold signals + ATAS — daily futures context

nodes.name: Daily trigger
nodes.notes: 22:30 UTC weekdays: after the 17:00 New York gold close and 15-minute feed delay, in either DST season.

nodes.name: Fetch ATAS summary
nodes.notes: Header Auth name=Authorization, value=Bearer <ADAPTER_TOKEN>. Upstream failures stop and alert via the error workflow.

nodes.name: Format ATAS context
nodes.notes: Validate a complete GC session and skip a session already posted.

nodes.name: Send ATAS context
nodes.notes: Only the separate private channel. Automatic send retries are disabled to reduce duplicate delivery after uncertain responses.

nodes.name: Mark session posted
nodes.notes: Persist session date after a successful Telegram send.
